verse: For in Him all things were created, things in heaven and on earth, visible and invisible, whether thrones or dominions or rulers or authorities. All things were created through Him and for Him. He is before all things, and in Him all things hold together.
story: Paul is describing the Christ that some wanted to reduce to one power among many.

In Him all things were created, in heaven and on earth, visible and invisible; He is before all things, and in Him all things hold together. The One who made everything is also the One keeping it from flying apart, this very moment included.
The world is not held together by luck, and not by you. It is held by Him.
